call_points.text: Management reaffirmed FY27 guidance to outperform underlying automotive industry volume growth by 1.5x to 2x.
Reiterated export revenue target of 14% to 15% of consolidated revenue by FY28.
Total 3-year capex outlay planned at ₹260-270 Cr, of which ₹80 Cr was spent in FY26.
SDPL greenfield chrome plating plant in Pune is in final stages of commissioning, doubling capacity.

Order book to be executed in FY27 covers over 85% of forecasted FY27 revenue.
Long-term sustainable EBITDA margin target is set at 27-28%, while maintaining a minimum threshold of 25%.
Reiterated guidance to outperform automotive industry growth by 1.5x to 2x in FY27.
Current order book to be executed in FY27 covers over 85% of FY27 forecasted revenue.
Investing ~₹100 Cr capex in greenfield chrome plating plant set up in Pune under SDPL.
Net cash position reached ₹243.7 Cr with total cash & cash equivalents of ₹251.4 Cr as of 31st March 2026.

timeline.summary: K A Joseph, Promoter of S.J.S. Enterprises Limited, disclosed no new share encumbrances beyond the 2,90,000 pledged to Bajaj Finance Limited (0.91% of capital) as of April 2, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹260.12 Cr (+29.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹48.49 Cr (+45.1% YoY).
SJS Enterprises announced FY27 guidance targeting 1.5x-2x industry volume outperformance and an export share target of 14-15% by FY28.
S.J.S. Enterprises presented its Q4 FY26 investor presentation, highlighting 29.7% YoY revenue growth and maintaining FY27 growth guidance of 1.5x-2x industry volume growth.
Thabraz Hushain W signed the earnings call recording for Q4 FY2026, available on May 6, 2026, at the company’s website.
S.J.S. Enterprises held its Q4FY26 earnings call, reiterating 1.5x-2x FY27 volume outperformance guidance and detailing its ₹260-270 Cr 3-year capex roadmap.
S.J.S. Enterprises Limited’s management will virtually participate in Centrum’s Nakshatra III Conference 2026 on May 22, 2026, at 11:00 a.m.
